description: Fetch one mission. view='summary' (the default, small enough to poll) returns its summary (activity, stage, review/check/test state, PR, paused and pauseSource, cost), its agent runs (sandboxId, role, status, harness, model, cost) and proofRunSandboxId (pass it to list_artifacts as sandboxId for the proof). view='full' adds its stages, events, stats and the plan/review/QA outcomes. pauseSource 'checkpoint:<role>' means a checkpoint holds it: resume_mission approves that stage. pauseSource 'qa-unverifiable' means QA could not check some acceptance criteria: answer_qa_checkpoint answers it. For a mission that needs attention, summary.escalation says whether an error or a platform judgement stopped it and summary.escalationCause holds the whole error. Requires the missions:read scope.

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-412

orgSlug.description: Narrow an issue id to one org

projectId.description: Narrow an issue id that two projects share

view.description: summary (default) for the state, runs and proof run; full for every stage, event and outcome

name: get_mission
title: Get mission detail
